title: Institutional Representation ABM: Parliamentary, Presidential, and Semi-Presidential Legislative Passage
description: An agent-based model comparing four democratic legislative institutions (pure parliamentary, pure republican/presidential, premier-presidential, president-parliamentary) on their ability to pass legislation, represent constituencies, and remain operational under party-system fragmentation and ideological polarisation. Includes a full statistical harness: N=200 seed multiseed comparison with bootstrap confidence intervals, Morris and Sobol sensitivity analyses, mechanism ablations, hung-parliament decomposition, and clustered-initialisation robustness checks. Companion code for arXiv:2608.24554.
